name: smwmusic-the-legend-of-prince-valiant-title-screen
title: The Legend of Prince Valiant - Title Screen
description:
The Title Screen theme from an odd NES game called The Legend of Prince Valiant, Developed and Published by Ocean.

Can fit your medieval levels, as well as retro castles.

There's an option in the .txt file to change between the NSF Rip and the ROM Rip.
